values.event_label: Revives the EIP: status Withdrawn back to Draft, adds a description frontmatter field, adds co-author Ben Adams, removes the placeholder 'Implementation: TBD' section and a gastoken.io URL (PR #10278, 'Move to Draft').
values.rationale: Process-status and metadata change; the specification content (intrinsic cost 7,000) is unchanged. Marked non-substantive as no normative text changed, though the revival is a significant lifecycle event; medium confidence for that judgement.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Move to Draft

values.event_label: Complete rewrite (PR #10283, 'Refresh and modernize'): TX_BASE_COST 21,000 to 8,000 with a warm/cold-accounting derivation; adds a GAS_NEW_ACCOUNT = 25,000 surcharge for value transfers creating a new (EIP-161 non-existent, non-precompile) account; adds frontmatter requires: 1559, 2718, 2929, 2930; adds execution-specs code-change example and parallelization rationale.
values.rationale: Replaces the proposal's normative content (new base value plus a new conditional surcharge) and introduces its first declared dependencies.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Refresh and modernize

values.event_label: Formalizes the specification (PR #10284): parameters table; enumerated new-account surcharge conditions; normative CalculateIntrinsicGas pseudocode; an 'Edits and interactions with other EIPs' section (EIP-2930, EIP-7702, EIP-7623); explicit test vectors 1-5; Backwards Compatibility restated as NOT backward compatible (consensus repricing at FORK_BLOCK).
values.rationale: Materially clarifies and extends normative behavior, adds test vectors, and reverses the backwards-compatibility claim.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: improve wording and clarify

values.event_label: Changes the recommended TX_BASE_COST from 8,000 to 6,000 (new TX_OVERHEAD_COST = 2,800 derivation), keeping the 8,000 derivation as a documented alternative; updates all dependent examples and test vectors (PR #10289).
values.rationale: The proposed normative parameter value changed.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Change recommendation to 6k

values.event_label: Adds a reference MGas/s-per-gaslimit/slot-time table and TPS @1.5s columns to the illustrative throughput tables (PR #10290).
values.rationale: Informative analysis tables only; no normative content changed.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add reference table

values.event_label: Adds a Solady ERC-20 transfer example line to the illustrative cost-change lists (PR #10293).
values.rationale: Illustrative example only.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add solady tx

values.event_label: Adds the 'Why not charge full tx data as calldata?' rationale section (signed-field coupling, serialization neutrality, EIP-7623/EIP-7976 policy targeting, native settlement) (PR #10295).
values.rationale: Rationale-only addition explaining a design decision; no change to what implementers do.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add rational to not price as calldata

values.event_label: Rephrases one rationale bullet ('pristine ETH transfers', 'permissioned ERC-20/LST/stable coin') (PR #10299).
values.rationale: Wording-only change in rationale.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Rephrase

values.event_label: Formatting and sentence consolidation in the transactions-per-block analysis; clarifies the current 10 MiB network block-size limits (PR #10300).
values.rationale: Formatting and wording in informative analysis only.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Formatting

values.event_label: Adds a figure image reference (assets/eip-2780/1.png) to the rationale (PR #10301).
values.rationale: Adds an illustrative graphic reference only.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add graph

values.event_label: Adds the 'Equivalent gas-limit increase' motivation analysis (+18.5% throughput equivalence, Perfnet headroom) and a new test case (block of minimal-gas contract executions with maximal contract-size addresses); normalizes unicode hyphens (PR #10304).
values.rationale: Mostly motivation analysis, but the added Test Cases entry affects testing scope, which the rubric treats as substantive; medium confidence on the borderline.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add equivalent gas-limit increase

values.event_label: Removes the documented alternative 8,000-gas derivation and its analysis tables, consolidating on the already-normative 6,000 value (PR #10305, 'Remove 8000').
values.rationale: The normative TX_BASE_COST was already 6,000; this deletes a non-normative alternative derivation and duplicate analysis. Medium confidence because it settles a previously presented design option.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Remove 8000

values.event_label: Adds a capacity-impact summary (average/max/equivalent-gaslimit) to the Abstract (PR #10306).
values.rationale: Informative summary only.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Update abstract

values.event_label: Adds co-author Maria Ines Silva (PR #10432).
values.rationale: Author-metadata change only.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Update authors

values.event_label: Adds co-author Anders Elowsson (PR #10591).
values.rationale: Author-metadata change only.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add author

values.event_label: Extends the proposal into a granular state-operation gas model (PR #10594, 'Include Call changes'): TX_BASE_COST 6,000 to 4,500; introduces STATE_UPDATE = 1,000, COLD_ACCOUNT_COST_CODE = 2,600, COLD_ACCOUNT_COST_NOCODE = 500, WARM_STATE_READ = 100; reprices value-moving calls (CALL_VALUE_COST 9,000 to 2,000, or 26,000 when creating an account); specifies a PAY-style primitive's warmth/code-load behavior, self-transfer rule, and warmth policy; adds transaction reference cases; EIP-2929 described as 'refined by this EIP'.
values.rationale: Major expansion of normative scope from intrinsic gas into EVM gas-schedule adjustments with a parameter change.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Include Call changes

values.event_label: Adds an explicit warmth-pricing specification that overrides EIP-2929's 'all tx addresses are warm' rule (per-type charges for tx.sender and tx.to, precompiles warm, access-list override), plus a 'Monetary Context' motivation section (PR #10595, 'Add context').
values.rationale: The warmth-decomposition block is normative and changes how intrinsic accounts are charged relative to EIP-2929.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add context

values.event_label: Rewrites the Monetary Context motivation into unit-of-account/medium-of-exchange/store-of-value/velocity/competition bullet points (PR #10596).
values.rationale: Motivation-only rewrite.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Bullet points

values.event_label: Adds co-author Anthony Sassano and a motivation note that the lower base applies to every transaction type (PR #10597, 'Feedback').
values.rationale: Author metadata plus a motivation note; no normative change.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Feedback

values.event_label: Clarifications with normative effect (PR #10598): CALL_VALUE_COST = 2,000 applies to all value-carrying calls regardless of prior account updates (2300-gas stipend safety); EIP-7702 senders must not trigger a disk code-load for classification; new-account surcharge component table restated; test vectors 7-14 added (warmth/access-list interplay, 7702 cases, precompile transfers, self-transfer, internal CALL repricing, Perfnet stress, SELFDESTRUCT); SELFDESTRUCT/EIP-6780 security note; throughput/payload/basefee levers section.
values.rationale: Materially clarifies normative charging rules and expands the test plan.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Clarifications

values.event_label: Reformats the Abstract's capacity-impact summary into a table with updated illustrative figures (+367% minimal txs, +250% ETH transfers at a 60M gaslimit) (PR #10616, 'Formatting').
values.rationale: Illustrative capacity figures in the abstract; not normative parameters.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Formatting

values.event_label: Adds a 'Monetary Effects' motivation section (velocity of money, moneyness) (PR #10617).
values.rationale: Motivation-only addition.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add Monetary Effects

values.event_label: Adds a minimum-economical-payment formula (v_min) and quantity-relation reasoning to the Monetary Effects section (PR #10618, 'Add formula').
values.rationale: Motivation-only mathematical illustration.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add formula

values.event_label: Fixes the normative pseudocode's syntax (text to python fence, // to # comments, false/False) without changing its logic (PR #11052).
values.rationale: Syntax-only change to pseudocode; semantics identical.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: fix pseudocode syntax

values.event_label: Fixes 'signiture' to 'signature' in the rationale (PR #11273).
values.rationale: Typo fix.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Minor wording fix

values.event_label: Fixes 'Thoughput' to 'Throughput' in the abstract table (PR #11333).
values.rationale: Typo fix.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: fix typo

values.event_label: Fixes minor text issues (missing space, 'unstablity' to 'instability') (PR #11347).
values.rationale: Typo fixes.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Fix minor text issues

values.event_label: Fixes typos and improves wording across the abstract, motivation, self-transfer note, and security section (PR #11371).
values.rationale: Wording-only changes.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: fix typos and improve wording

values.event_label: Adds TRANSFER_LOG_COST = 1,756 for the EIP-7708 transfer log (PR #11493): plain ETH transfer becomes 7,756; CALL_VALUE_COST becomes 3,756 / 27,756 (1,000 for self-calls); intrinsic pseudocode gains a transfer-log branch; removes the PAY-style primitive provisions; adds 'requires: 7708' and an EIP-7708 interactions entry; updates all examples and test vectors.
values.rationale: New charge, changed formulas, removed provision, and a new declared dependency.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add transfer log cost, remove PAY

values.event_label: Clarifies interactions with other EIPs (PR #11332): EIP-7702-delegated recipients charged COLD_ACCOUNT_COST_CODE plus a delegation-target cold/warm charge; adds an EIP-7928 (Block-Level Access Lists) entry specifying out-of-gas and BAL-inclusion semantics for the two-tier cold-access model; adds 7702-delegated rows to the reference cases and reprices zero-value transactions (recipient lookup now charged).
values.rationale: Adds normative charging rules for delegated accounts and BAL edge cases.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Clarify interactions with other EIPs

values.event_label: Adds missing EIP-7708 log costs for CREATE with endowment (PR #11586): top-level CREATE transactions with value > 0 now pay TRANSFER_LOG_COST; pseudocode condition updated; expands the EIP-7708 interaction entry (LOG3 transfer and LOG2 burn events, in-EVM charging sites deferred to EIP-7708).
values.rationale: Changes which transactions pay a charge (normative condition change).
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Add missing 7708 log costs for CREATE with endowment

values.event_label: Full rework as 'Resource-based intrinsic transaction gas' (PR #11645): retitles the EIP; decomposes the flat 21,000 into TX_BASE_COST = 12,000, COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS = 3,000 (per EIP-8038), TX_VALUE_COST = 4,244, TRANSFER_LOG_COST = 1,756 so a plain transfer still totals 21,000; state-growing transactions pay STATE_BYTES_PER_NEW_ACCOUNT x CPSB = 183,600 in EIP-8037 state gas; requires becomes 161, 2718, 2929, 2930, 6780, 7702, 7708, 7904, 7928, 8037, 8038; empirical derivation from EELS benchmarks at a 100 Mgas/s anchor; new reference cases and test cases.
values.rationale: Wholesale respecification of the proposal's normative model, parameters, and dependencies.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Rework as resource-based intrinsic transaction gas

values.event_label: Requires EIP-7523 instead of EIP-161 (PR #11828): the new-account condition changes from 'empty per EIP-161' to 'non-existent', justified by EIP-7523's guarantee that post-merge state contains no empty accounts.
values.rationale: Swaps a declared dependency and reformulates the normative account-creation condition on the new basis.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: require EIP-7523 instead of EIP-161

values.event_label: Clarifies out-of-gas handling for the top-level state-dependent charges (PR #11834): insufficient gas for the new-account state charge or delegation access does not invalidate the transaction; it is included, halts as exceptional out-of-gas, pays for gas consumed, and reverts; adds test case 10.
values.rationale: Defines validity and halt semantics that implementations must follow.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: clarify OOG handling for top-level gas charges

values.event_label: Accounts for the EIP-7623 calldata floor base (PR #11836): with this EIP active, the flat 21,000 term in EIP-7623's floor is replaced by the transaction's decomposed regular-gas intrinsic; adds '7623' to requires.
values.rationale: Changes how another active EIP's formula is computed under this proposal; new declared dependency.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: account for EIP-7623 calldata floor base

values.event_label: Splits charging into intrinsic (state-independent, sole validity input) and runtime (state-dependent, charged as the first frame is entered) phases (PR #11844): decomposes EIP-7702 authorization cost (REGULAR_PER_AUTH_BASE_COST = 7,816 intrinsic; per-authority ACCOUNT_WRITE, new-account state gas, and delegation-indicator state bytes at runtime), replacing PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST and its refund; recipient/authority touches charged unconditionally at the cold rate; delegation-target access moves to runtime cold/warm; LIFO state-gas refill semantics; adds co-author Dragan Rakita; removes the textual EIP-7523 explanation during the restructure.
values.rationale: Major normative restructuring of when and how charges are applied and of 7702 authorization pricing.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: move state-dependent charges to runtime (cold surcharge, new-account state gas)

values.event_label: Clarifies runtime charging rules (PR #11891): enumerates when the per-authority ACCOUNT_WRITE charge is skipped (authority is tx.sender, was written by a preceding authorization, or is tx.to of a value-bearing transaction); refines BAL/warmth wording for the recipient and the semantics of out-of-gas inside vs before the first frame.
values.rationale: Materially changes/clarifies which authorizations pay ACCOUNT_WRITE.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: clarify 2780

values.event_label: Restructures the runtime phase into an ordered pre-execution sequence (gas split per EIP-8037, 7702 authorization processing, BAL recipient insertion, account creation/access charges) with subsections; rewrites the abstract; drops '7904' from requires (its last textual mention, in the per-auth derivation, is removed here) (PR #11906, multi-file commit shared with EIP-8038, from which the authorization-pricing section was simultaneously removed).
values.rationale: Reorganizes and refines normative pre-execution semantics and changes the declared dependency set.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: align with recent EIP-2780 changes

values.event_label: Folds TRANSFER_LOG_COST into TX_VALUE_COST = 6,000 (PR #11997): the separate 1,756 log parameter is removed; value-bearing contract-creation transactions no longer pay a separate value charge (covered by CREATE_ACCESS, totals drop from 24,756 to 23,000); drops '7523' from requires (no textual reference remained).
values.rationale: Parameter restructuring that changes charged totals for create transactions and the declared dependency set.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: fold transfer log cost into TX_VALUE_COST

values.event_label: Moves frontmatter status from Draft to Review (PR #12038). For this file the commit changes only the status line (the same multi-file commit also edited eip-8038.md).
values.rationale: Process-status metadata change only for this file.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: Move to Review

values.event_label: Renames REGULAR_PER_AUTH_BASE_COST to EXECUTION_PER_AUTH_BASE_COST and 'regular gas' to 'execution gas' throughout, aligning nomenclature with EIP-8037 (PR #12052, 'variable rename + 8007 clean-ups'; '8007' appears to be a typo for 8037).
values.rationale: Pure nomenclature alignment with the upstream EIP; no values, conditions, or semantics change. Medium confidence because it rewrites normative text wholesale, albeit mechanically.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: variable rename + 8007 clean-ups

values.event_label: Updates the EIP-8038-referenced values used by this EIP (PR #12083, multi-file commit shared with EIP-8038): ACCOUNT_WRITE 8,000 to 9,000 and CREATE_ACCESS 11,000 to 12,000, raising create-transaction intrinsic totals from 23,000 to 24,000.
values.rationale: Referenced parameter values and resulting reference-case totals changed.
values.source_title: Update EIP-2780: revise COLD_STORAGE_ACCESS and ACCOUNT_WRITE values

values.event_label: Uncertain transition
values.rationale: Commit e338bc94 (PR #11853) removed the 'Considered for Inclusion' heading, leaving the whole CFI list rendered under the 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' heading. The PR body describes its intent as a stage restructuring that adds EIP-8282 and EIP-7610 to Considered for Inclusion, and the same-day correction PR #11917 states the changes 'were not completely correct'. Three days later the ACDE #241 call (2026-07-16) recorded that Glamsterdam EIPs were 'not yet moved to SFI' (ACDbot summary, 00:25:12), confirming no scheduling decision existed on 2026-07-13, so the apparent SFI placement is treated as an editorial error and normalized to unknown rather than scheduled_for_inclusion.

values.rationale: Correction commit (PR #11917) restoring the 'Considered for Inclusion' section and this EIP's placement in it, hours after PR #11853's erroneous restructuring. It re-establishes the previously decided CFI status rather than recording a new inclusion decision (and is not a removal from schedule), so it is normalized to unknown; the restored state is 'Considered for Inclusion'.

values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 7a8f203e5e8b (Update EIP-7773: re-add CFI/restore EIP-8136/EIP-8189 status)

values.event_label: SFI
values.rationale: The Meta EIP change moves the EIP from 'Considered for Inclusion' to 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' and removes the CFI section. PR #12022 attributes the promotion of all remaining Core CFI EIPs to the ACDC #183 (2026-07-23) decisions; the ACDC #183 minutes record 'All devnet-7 EIPs ratified SFI; PRs to update EIP statuses will be opened' with testing (EthPandaOps) and EL teams confirming readiness (ACDbot summary, 00:21:33). The SFI question had been raised at ACDE #241 (2026-07-16). The historical SFI term maps directly to scheduled_for_inclusion. EIP-7773 remains a Draft; SFI does not mean deployed or final.

values.eip_label: EIP-7708 · ETH transfers emit a log
values.event_label: Revival and first full specification pass (PR open for fourteen months). Status Stagnant -> Draft; adds Etan Kissling, Gajinder Singh and Carson as co-authors. Replaces the placeholder 'Parameters / MAGIC: TBD' section with a concrete 'ETH transfer logs' section: the emitting address becomes SYSTEM_ADDRESS 0xfff...ffe (citing EIP-4788), topics[0] becomes keccak256('Transfer(address,address,uint256)') (0xddf252ad...), topics[1]/topics[2] the zero-padded from/to addresses and data the big-endian uint256 amount, explicitly matching the ERC-20 Transfer event. Restricts the SELFDESTRUCT transfer log to SELFDESTRUCT to a different account and adds a new 'Selfdestruct processing' section defining a LOG2-shaped log with topics[0] = keccak256('Selfdestruct(address,uint256)') (0x4bfaba34...) for SELFDESTRUCT to the same account. Rewrites the open questions to ask which magic emitter address to use.
values.rationale: Turns an under-specified sketch into an implementable log encoding: it fixes the emitter address, the topic hashes, the data encoding and the log arity, and adds an entirely new log kind for self-directed SELFDESTRUCT. Every one of these changes affects client implementation and test generation.

values.eip_label: EIP-7708 · ETH transfers emit a log

values.rationale: Adds a new emission trigger, a new block-position rule and a new ordering rule, and redefines a topic's meaning; all are directly implementation- and test-visible.

values.eip_label: EIP-7778 · Block Gas Accounting without Refunds
values.event_label: Revival and complete rewrite, 193 lines down to 88. Status Stagnant -> Draft; title becomes 'Block Gas Limit Accounting without Refunds' and the description 'Prevent Block Gas Limit Circumvention by Excluding Refunds from Block Gas Accounting'; Toni Wahrstaetter is added as co-author. The scope narrows from 'certain gas discounts and refunds' to refunds alone (specifically SSTORE-to-zero), with warm-access and revert-to-original discounts explicitly retained in block accounting. The specification is restated as two rules - user gas cost stays tx.gas_used = gas_used - gas_refund, and block gas accounting becomes block.gas_used += gas_used with refunds not subtracted - plus a Block Gas Limit Enforcement section. The whole EIP-7623/EIP-4844 data-availability framing, the combined calldata-floor formula, the Implementation section and the DA-heavy test cases are removed; the document is reorganised into standard EIP sections with new Rationale, Backwards Compatibility, Test Cases and Security Considerations.
values.rationale: Rewrites every normative statement in the EIP, narrows what is excluded from block gas accounting, and removes the coupling to EIP-7623 that the original specification was built on. The resulting rule is what later revisions refine.

values.eip_label: EIP-7778 · Block Gas Accounting without Refunds
values.event_label: Brings the EIP-7623 calldata floor back into both accounting formulas. Section 1 is retitled 'User and Receipt Gas Accounting (Unchanged)' and its rule becomes gas_used = max(tx_gas_used - gas_refund, calldata_floor_gas_cost); the block rule becomes block.gas_used += max(tx_gas_used, calldata_floor_gas_cost), explicitly citing the calldata floor from EIP-7623 (./eip-7623.md). The receipt note added by the previous revision and the separate 'Block Gas Limit Enforcement' section are deleted.
values.rationale: Changes both normative formulas by introducing a max() against the calldata floor, which alters the gas charged for calldata-heavy transactions at both levels, and reintroduces an explicit dependency on EIP-7623.

values.eip_label: EIP-7778 · Block Gas Accounting without Refunds
values.event_label: Adds a 'Receipt Changes' rule: cumulative_gas_used now carries gas before refunds so it matches block gas accounting, and a NEW receipt field gas_spent carries the post-refund gas the user pays. The 'User and Receipt Gas Accounting (Unchanged)' item is deleted, block accounting becomes item 1, Backwards Compatibility is rewritten to announce the receipt structure change, and test case 3 becomes 'Receipt Fields'.
values.rationale: Changes the receipt data structure - a consensus-relevant, RPC-visible object - by redefining an existing field's semantics and adding a new one. This is the widest blast radius any revision of this EIP reached.

values.rationale: The preceding commit had deleted the user-facing rule while introducing the receipt field, leaving the user cost formula unstated. Restoring it - now naming the quantity gas_spent to match the new receipt field - resolves that gap in the normative text. Grouped with the receipt-field episode it belongs to.

Blank lines are inserted after the two remaining list headings. The user gas accounting item added by the previous commit is kept.
values.rationale: Removes a receipt-structure change from the specification nine days after it was added, returning the EIP to a pure block-accounting change. Closes the receipt-field change group. This is the last substantive revision at the pinned state.

values.event_label: Moves slot computation from the execution layer to the consensus layer and adds the plumbing for it. A new 'RPC changes' section states that the slot number is calculated in the consensus layer and passed to the execution layer through the engine API, adds a slot_number uint64 parameter to engine_newPayload, extends the engine API PayloadAttributes object with a slot_number uint64 field, and lets consensus clients optionally expose eth_getSlotNumberFromTimestamp and eth_getTimestampFromSlotNumber. Adds the 'Calculation in consensus layer' rationale and rewrites the Motivation and the encrypted-mempool sub-section as an example application; description becomes 'Precompile to get the current slot number'.
values.rationale: Introduces new cross-layer interface surface (engine API parameter and PayloadAttributes field, plus two optional JSON-RPC methods) that clients must implement, so the change is substantive and interface-shaped.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 7f01d7b262fd: Update EIP-7843: calculate slot in CL, improve motivation

values.event_label: Replaces the 'newPayload change' sub-section with a 'Header extension': instead of an engine_newPayload parameter, the execution block header encoding is extended with a slot_number uint64 field. Adds a 'ZK-VM proving' rationale arguing that SLOT does not increase proving complexity because the slot number now lives in the header, keeping the block self-contained for proving.
values.rationale: Relocating the slot number from an engine API parameter into the block header changes the block data structure, block hashing and header validation for every client, so this is a substantive interface change despite being an eight-line diff.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit b9726100a21e: Update EIP-7793: zk-vm sections

values.event_label: Single-line wording fix in the Specification: 'SLOT returns as output the current slot number as an 8 byte ulong in big endian encoding' becomes '... as an 8-byte uint64 in big-endian encoding'.
values.rationale: Renames the width in standard EVM/SSZ terminology and hyphenates two compounds. An 8 byte ulong and an 8-byte uint64 are the same value, so no implementation-visible detail changes.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 270874f063cf: Update EIP-7843: specification update

values.event_label: Converts the proposal from a precompile to an opcode and gives it a concrete encoding: title becomes 'SLOTNUM opcode', description 'Opcode to get the current slot number', discussions-to moves to the slotnum-opcode topic, and the Specification now reads 'A new opcode SLOTNUM is introduced at 0x4b. It shall return one stack element', with an Output stack table and 'SlotNumber is an 8 byte uint in big endian encoding'; the fixed gas cost of 2 is retained. The Motivation is rewritten around two existing ways to obtain the slot number on chain - computing it from the block timestamp, or supplying it as calldata and proving it against the beacon block root using EIP-4788 - and the two optional JSON-RPC conversion endpoints and the 'Precompile' rationale sub-section are deleted.
values.rationale: Changes the instruction form (precompile to opcode), assigns the opcode byte 0x4b, replaces the return-data encoding with a stack result, and removes previously specified optional RPC surface. This is the largest normative change in the file's history and is also the commit that first names another EIP.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 0aefdc9d5a4b: Update EIP-7843: change to opcode

values.event_label: Frontmatter status Draft -> Review, and the Output sub-section's stack table (a 'Stack' heading plus a two-column table giving top - 0 = SlotNumber, followed by 'SlotNumber is an 8 byte uint in big endian encoding') is collapsed into one prose sentence: 'One element SlotNumber is added to the stack; it is equal to the corresponding slot number for this block. SlotNumber is a uint64 in big endian encoding.'
values.rationale: Process-status metadata plus a presentation change that restates the same single stack output in prose. Confidence is medium rather than high because the prose drops the explicit 'top - 0' position marker, but the surrounding text already states that the opcode returns exactly one stack element, so no behaviour is added or removed.

values.event_label: Rewrites the EIP-7702 delegation edge case: authority included on successful set/update/clear; inclusion on failed authorization depends on whether the authority was loaded; delegation target included only when loaded as an execution target.

values.source_title: Update EIP-7928: Clarify wording around 7702

values.rationale: Substantial new normative machinery governing BAL inclusion; deepens the EIP-2929 and EIP-7702 relationships (see dependency_history).
values.source_title: Update EIP-7928: Further clarify access

values.event_label: CREATE/CREATE2 targets included only 'if the target account is accessed'; COINBASE inclusion narrowed to withdrawals to the COINBASE address; storage_read->storage_reads naming and wording fixes.
values.rationale: Changes normative inclusion conditions.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7928: clarify access

values.source_title: Update EIP-7928: cap max items in BAL

values.source_title: Update EIP-7928: Clarify anti-dos measure for invalid, bloated BALs

values.event_label: Adds uniqueness constraints: unique addresses, storage keys at most once per list, no key in both storage_changes and storage_reads, unique block_access_index per change list.

values.event_label: Re-parameterises the surcharge in terms of the EIP-7623 token abstraction. The two EIP-owned constants ACCESS_LIST_NONZERO_BYTE_COST and ACCESS_LIST_ZERO_BYTE_COST are replaced in the parameter table by TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN = 10, sourced from EIP-7623, and the formula becomes access_list_tokens = nonzero * 4 + zero followed by access_list_data_cost = access_list_tokens * TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN. Description, Abstract and Motivation are rewritten (adding the '~21% worst-case block size reduction' claim and the 'contributing to EVM gas while still leaving a non-negligible data footprint' framing); 'Maximum Block Size Impact' is renamed 'Access List Size Impact' and recomputed at a 60M gas limit (1012 KB -> 604 KB); a new 'Maximum Block Size Impact' section states the Snappy-compressed maximum falls from 2.71 MiB to 2.13 MiB. The description acquires the typo 'footpring'.
values.rationale: The effective rates are numerically unchanged (4 tokens * 10 = 40 gas per non-zero byte, 1 token * 10 = 10 gas per zero byte), but the EIP stops owning its pricing constants and instead derives them from another EIP's TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN. That makes the charge track future changes to EIP-7623 - as the next two revisions demonstrate - so it is a substantive change to the specification even though no gas value moves in this commit.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 5aea12c20ee2: Update EIP-7976: improve wording

values.event_label: Retargets the floor constant from EIP-7623 to EIP-7976: 'requires' becomes 2930, 7976 and TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN becomes 15 (sourced from EIP-7976) instead of 10, raising the surcharge to 60 gas per non-zero byte and 15 per zero byte (~3600 gas per address, ~3820 per storage key). The Motivation's floor-pricing reference switches to EIP-7976, all worked numbers and the reference-implementation constants are recomputed, and the compressed-block-size claim moves from 2.13 MiB to approximately 1.7 MiB. The title is capitalised to 'Increase Access List Cost' and the description typo 'footpring' is corrected to 'Price access lists for data to reduce maximum block size'.
values.rationale: A 50 per cent increase in the data surcharge, driven by adopting a different EIP's floor constant. Both the gas values and the declared dependency change.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 0fdeb4ce5d59: Update EIP-7981: use 7976 reference, update eip name

values.event_label: Restructures the EIP from a standalone surcharge into a modification of the EIP-7623 floor itself. 'requires' becomes 2930, 7623 and TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN returns to 10 sourced from EIP-7623 (Motivation reference reverted too). Access list tokens are now added to access_list_cost AND folded into the floor: total_data_tokens = tokens_in_calldata + tokens_in_access_list, data_floor_gas_cost = TX_BASE_COST + TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN * total_data_tokens. A full tx.gasUsed formula with the max() of execution-side and floor-side costs is given, plus a new validity rule: a transaction with a gas limit below 21000 + TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN * total_data_tokens, or below its intrinsic gas cost, is invalid. The Rationale is replaced, ALL THREE test cases are deleted, the reference implementation is rewritten around calculate_access_list_tokens and a combined intrinsic/floor return, and Security Considerations is rewritten.
values.rationale: Changes what the EIP does: access list data now participates in the transaction floor calculation rather than only being surcharged, and a new transaction-validity condition is introduced. This changes gas outcomes for transactions whose execution cost sits below the floor, and adds a new invalidity case clients must enforce.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 1356811a1522: Update EIP-7981: add access list cost to eip-7623 floor formula

values.event_label: Aligns with EIP-7976's updated calldata floor. 'requires' becomes 2930, 7623, 7976 and TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN becomes 16, sourced from EIP-7976. The zero/non-zero weighting is dropped from the floor: floor_tokens_in_access_list = access_list_bytes * 4 and floor_tokens_in_calldata = (zero_bytes + nonzero_bytes) * 4, so every byte now counts as four tokens regardless of value; total_data_tokens is renamed total_floor_data_tokens throughout, including in the validity rule. The reference implementation is rewritten to sum byte lengths instead of inspecting byte values.
values.rationale: Both the constant (10 -> 16) and the tokenisation rule change: a zero byte in an access list goes from 1 token to 4 tokens, so the surcharge rises from 10 to 64 gas per zero byte and from 40 to 64 gas per non-zero byte. Implementations and tests must change.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 87def23e7d59: Update EIP-7981: Align with EIP-7976 updates

values.event_label: Adds one sentence after the token definition: the access list data is 'equivalently' charged 64 gas per byte, i.e. 1280 gas per address and 2048 gas per storage key, and the token abstraction is retained only for consistency with EIP-7623 and EIP-7976.
values.rationale: An arithmetic restatement of the rule established by the preceding commit (4 tokens per byte * 16 gas per token = 64 gas per byte); no rule, constant or formula changes and no ambiguity is resolved. Confidence is medium rather than high because stating the effective per-byte rate explicitly does make the cost easier to implement, and the next revision adopts exactly this framing as the normative one.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 15e4f96ccd6a: Update EIP-7976: clarify token abstraction

values.event_label: Rewrites the reference implementation in plainer Python: type annotations and the Uint wrapper are dropped, calculate_access_list_floor_tokens becomes a one-line sum() comprehension, calldata zero-byte counting moves into a count_zero_bytes helper, and TX_ACCESS_LIST_* constant names become ACCESS_LIST_*. The computed values are unchanged.
values.rationale: Presentation of illustrative pseudocode. Every arithmetic result the reference implementation produces is identical before and after.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 706296e06bf9: Update EIP-7981: Simplify pseudocode in reference implementation

values.event_label: Simplifies the specification back to a flat surcharge (contributed by Pawel Bylica). The access list floor-token machinery is deleted: access_list_data_cost = 64 * access_list_bytes (1280 per address, 2048 per storage key), stated to match the EIP-7976 calldata floor rate, and this surcharge is added to tx.gasUsed OUTSIDE the max(), leaving the EIP-2930 access_list_cost and the EIP-7976 floor calculation untouched - the floor term reverts to TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN * floor_tokens_in_calldata. The validity rule becomes 'any transaction with a gas limit below tx.gasUsed evaluated with execution_gas_used = 0 is invalid'.
values.rationale: Reverses the structural change made on 2026-01-21: access list data no longer enters the floor calculation and is charged unconditionally instead. The specification's shape, the validity rule and the interaction with EIP-7976 all change, even though the effective 64 gas per byte matches the preceding revision for transactions above the floor.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 71d3353c3f67: Update EIP-7981: Simplify spec

values.event_label: Brings the reference implementation into line with the flat-surcharge specification: calculate_access_list_floor_tokens becomes calculate_access_list_data_cost returning total_bytes * 64, the surcharge is kept separate from the EIP-2930 access_list_cost, and it is added to BOTH the returned intrinsic_gas and the returned floor_gas. The docstring now states the intended identity tx.gasUsed = max(intrinsic_gas + execution_gas_used, floor_gas).
values.rationale: The preceding commit changed the prose but left a reference implementation that still folded access list tokens into the floor, so the document was internally inconsistent for two days. This commit resolves that and, in doing so, states how the surcharge-outside-the-max formulation is realised in code (added to both branches) - a detail the prose does not spell out and that implementations and tests depend on. Grouped with the flat-surcharge rework it completes. This is the last substantive revision at the pinned state.

values.event_label: Complete redesign: the EIP stops specifying a new predeploy and instead formalises the already-deployed 'Arachnid' keyless factory. Title becomes 'Deterministic Factory Contract'; Toni Wahrstaetter and Nick Johnson are added as co-authors; 'requires' drops 211 and keeps 1014. FACTORY_ADDRESS becomes 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C and the runtime code becomes 0x7fffffff...6014600cf3. The requirement is restated as 'the chain's state MUST include FACTORY_ADDRESS with nonce 1 and this runtime code', satisfiable by an ordinary (including keyless) transaction, by genesis inclusion, or by an irregular state transition. Behaviour differences from the previous factory are spelled out: an input shorter than 32 bytes causes an attempted ~2^256-byte calldatacopy and reverts as a result; a failed creation reverts with EMPTY return data rather than propagating the creation frame's data; the created address is returned as exactly 20 unpadded bytes. Motivation is condensed and re-argued around keyless transactions becoming undeployable as gas schedules change. The whole previous Rationale is replaced by a 'Choice of factory' section (about 25000 mainnet uses, hundreds of chains, EIP-1014 compatibility, no PUSH0 dependency per EIP-3855, and the two accepted downsides). Backwards Compatibility becomes 'no issues; a no-op on chains that already have it'. The Test Cases section is deleted and a Yul-equivalent listing replaces the assembly listing.
values.rationale: Replaces the specified contract, its address, its bytecode, its revert and return-data semantics, and the mechanism by which a chain satisfies the EIP. Nothing normative survives from the previous specification; this is the single largest change in the file's history.

If deployed using an irregular state transition, the nonce SHOULD be set to 1.'

values.event_label: Shifts the EXCHANGE operand encoding down by one so the assembly operands match the intended SWAP-like indexing. decode_pair returns (q + 1, r + 1) / (r + 1, 29 - q) instead of (q + 2, r + 2) / (r + 2, 30 - q), and encode_pair's assertion and arithmetic change from '2 <= n <= 14 and n < m <= 30 and n + m <= 32' with the m <= 17 branch to '1 <= n <= 13 and n < m <= 29 and n + m <= 30' with the m <= 16 branch. A Rationale paragraph is added explaining that the operands look off by one because EXCHANGE n m operates on stack depths n + 1 and m + 1, chosen so that EXCHANGE n m is equivalent to SWAP{n} SWAP{m} SWAP{n}. Two disassembly test cases are renumbered accordingly (e812 becomes EXCHANGE 2 3, e8d0 becomes EXCHANGE 1 19).
values.rationale: Changes the immediate-to-operand mapping of a new instruction, so every assembler, disassembler and EVM implementation of EXCHANGE, and its test vectors, change with it.

values.eip_label: EIP-8024 · Backward compatible SWAPN, DUPN, EXCHANGE
values.event_label: Rewrites the 'Disallowed immediate range' rationale. The new text first states the EVM property being preserved (it is not possible to jump into the middle of an instruction, which PUSH immediates uphold by being masked from JUMPDEST analysis), then explains that these instructions preserve it without changing JUMPDEST analysis by forbidding 0x5b and 0x60-0x7f in their immediates, then gives the masked-opcode alternative and why it would break backwards compatibility without bytecode versioning (EOF), and finally notes that the encoding can be reused by future immediate-carrying instructions. 'counterfactual deployments-in-waiting' becomes 'included in transactions yet to be published on chain'. The sentence saying it would be safe to allow 0x5c to 0x5f is deleted.
values.rationale: Confined to the Rationale section. The disallowed immediate ranges, the instruction algorithms, the encode/decode functions and every test vector are unchanged, so nothing an implementer or test author consumes moves.

values.eip_label: EIP-8024 · Backward compatible SWAPN, DUPN, EXCHANGE
values.event_label: Re-encodes all three immediates branchlessly and widens EXCHANGE. decode_single becomes (x + 145) % 256 and encode_single (n + 111) % 256, replacing the two-branch +17 / -20 form; decode_pair replaces 'k = x if x <= 79 else x - 48' with 'k = x ^ 143' and encode_pair returns 'k ^ 143'. EXCHANGE's invalid immediate range widens from 79 < x < 128 to 81 < x < 128 (so 0x50 and 0x51 become valid), decode_pair's assertion admits x <= 81 and encode_pair's admits n <= 14. Every assembly and execution test vector is re-encoded to the new immediates (for example DUPN 17 is now e680 rather than e600, EXCHANGE 2 3 is e89d rather than e812), e850 changes from INVALID_EXCHANGE, POP to EXCHANGE 14 16, and e851 / e852 are added.
values.rationale: Changes the byte-level encoding of every immediate for all three instructions and the set of valid EXCHANGE operand pairs. The most disruptive revision after creation: all previously published bytecode examples and test vectors become invalid.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit d0b75a60e8b8: Update EIP-8024: Switch to branchless normalization and extend EXCHANGE

values.event_label: Adds docstrings recording the output ranges of the decoders ('Returns n with 17 <= n <= 235' and 'Returns (n, m) with 1 <= n <= 14 and n < m <= 30 - n') and simplifies encode_pair's assertion from '1 <= n <= 14 and n < m <= 29 and n + m <= 30' to '1 <= n < m and n + m <= 30'.
values.rationale: The simplified assertion is equivalent to the one it replaces: given 1 <= n < m and n + m <= 30, n <= 14 and m <= 29 both follow. The docstrings restate ranges already implied by the assertions. No behaviour, encoding or test vector changes.

values.rationale: Changes the deployment mechanism, removes a constant, adds new system-call and revert rules and changes when the fee is updated; all are implementation- and test-visible.
